project: AI Radar public GitHub selected style

headings.expression: (()=>{const vis=e=>e.checkVisibility({checkOpacity:true,checkVisibilityCSS:true})&&e.getClientRects().length>0;const n=[...document.querySelectorAll("#main h1, #main h2:not(.sr-only), #main h3")].filter(vis);const bad=n.filter(e=>!((e,c)=>Number(c.fontWeight)<=600)(e,getComputedStyle(e)));return {pass:bad.length===0,samples:n.length,detail:bad.length+'/'+n.length+' fail: 字重>600'}})()

controls.expression: (()=>{const vis=e=>e.checkVisibility({checkOpacity:true,checkVisibilityCSS:true})&&e.getClientRects().length>0;const n=[...document.querySelectorAll("a.rounded-full, button.rounded-full:not([aria-hidden]), select.rounded-full, .ui-button, .ui-select, [data-pill-track] > a, [data-pill-track] > button, [role=search] input:not([type=hidden]), .admin-btn, .admin-input, .admin-chip")].filter(vis);const bad=n.filter(e=>!((e,c)=>parseFloat(c.borderTopLeftRadius)<=6)(e,getComputedStyle(e)));return {pass:bad.length===0,samples:n.length,detail:bad.length+'/'+n.length+' fail: 圆角>6px'}})()

primary.expression: (()=>{const vis=e=>e.checkVisibility({checkOpacity:true,checkVisibilityCSS:true})&&e.getClientRects().length>0;const n=[...document.querySelectorAll(".ui-button--primary, a.bg-accent.text-accent-contrast:not([aria-current]), button.bg-accent.text-accent-contrast, .admin-btn--primary")].filter(vis);const bad=n.filter(e=>!((e,c)=>c.backgroundColor==="rgb(31, 136, 61)")(e,getComputedStyle(e)));return {pass:bad.length===0,samples:n.length,detail:bad.length+'/'+n.length+' fail: 非绿色主按钮'}})()

labels.expression: (()=>{const vis=e=>e.checkVisibility({checkOpacity:true,checkVisibilityCSS:true})&&e.getClientRects().length>0;const n=[...document.querySelectorAll("span.rounded-full[class*=\"bg-amber-soft\"], span.rounded-full[class*=\"bg-accent-soft\"], span.rounded-full[class*=\"bg-hot-soft\"], span.rounded-full[class*=\"bg-ok-soft\"], .admin-badge")].filter(vis);const bad=n.filter(e=>!((e,c)=>c.backgroundColor==="rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)")(e,getComputedStyle(e)));return {pass:bad.length===0,samples:n.length,detail:bad.length+'/'+n.length+' fail: 标签非透明底'}})()

nav-current.expression: (()=>{const vis=e=>e.checkVisibility({checkOpacity:true,checkVisibilityCSS:true})&&e.getClientRects().length>0;const n=[...document.querySelectorAll(".site-sidebar a[aria-current=page], nav[aria-label=\"\u5e95\u90e8\u5bfc\u822a\"] a[aria-current=page]")].filter(vis);const bad=n.filter(e=>!((e,c)=>Number(c.fontWeight)>=600)(e,getComputedStyle(e)));return {pass:bad.length===0,samples:n.length,detail:bad.length+'/'+n.length+' fail: 当前项非600'}})()
